stdout:
List videos. Use this tool to list videos.

Usage:
  yutu video list [flags]

Examples:
# List a video by ID
yutu video list --ids IBju0NwjQRc
# List multiple videos in JSON format
yutu video list --ids IBju0NwjQRc,wZ9z3FUuNvQ --output json
# List most popular videos by region
yutu video list --chart mostPopular --regionCode US --maxResults 10
# List my liked videos
yutu video list --myRating like --output yaml

Flags:
  -c, --chart string                    chartUnspecified|mostPopular
  -h, --help                            help for list
  -l, --hl string                       Specifies the localization language
  -i, --ids strings                     Return videos with the given ids
  -L, --locale string                   Locale of the video metadata to return
  -H, --maxHeight int                   Max height of the embedded player in pixels
  -n, --maxResults int                  The maximum number of items that should be returned, 0 for no limit (default 5)
  -W, --maxWidth int                    Max width of the embedded player in pixels
  -R, --myRating string                 Return videos liked/disliked by the authenticated user
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string   ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -o, --output string                   json|yaml|table (default "table")
  -p, --parts strings                   Comma separated parts (default [id,snippet,status,statistics])
  -r, --regionCode string               Specific to the specified region
  -g, --videoCategoryId string          Category of the video
